items.headline: $ATOM Wallets Drained? 2,266 Staked Tokens Moved
items.summary: Cosmos saw 2,266 staked $ATOM moved from six accounts, with one delegator reporting theft. Web3Auth claims some transfers are protective recoveries.

items.headline: $SKY TVL Slides 15% as $USDS Supply Shrinks
items.summary: Sky's TVL fell 15% in a week while $USDS supply contracted to $5.59B. The savings rate now sits at 3.80% per governance.

items.headline: Robinhood Chain Mainnet Goes Live on $ARB Stack
items.summary: Robinhood opened its Arbitrum-based L2 publicly with stock tokens, Morpho-powered lending and agentic trading, eyeing Canada, Singapore and UK expansion.

items.headline: Bullish Picks $APT for Tokenized Shares Push
items.summary: Bullish chose Solana, Aptos and Ethereum for tokenized shares. $BLSH already trades tokenized on Solana, with $APT and ETH launches undated.

items.headline: 13 $JPMD Copycat Tokens Pop Up After JPMorgan Launch
items.summary: A wave of $JPMD lookalike tokens emerged alongside JPMorgan's Ethereum-based deposit token rollout — traders beware of fakes.
